name: check_reactivation_eligibility
description: check_reactivation_eligibility: Validate an occupational health clearance code and determine which suspended privileges are available for reactivation. Returns eligible: true and the list of suspended privilege codes on success.

clearance_code.description: The occupational health clearance code issued to the provider. Format: CLR-2-4 uppercase letters-6 digits. Example: CLR-OCC-048271
